meta.disclaimer: Coupon rates below are ILLUSTRATIVE, not real outstanding JGB issues. They were chosen to sit near current tenor yields (see data/jgb_curve_loader.py) so each bond prices near par under the loaded curve, which makes pricing-engine output easy to sanity-check by eye. Substituting real ISINs and their actual coupons would be a credibility upgrade for a later iteration; this belongs in the Phase 6 validation report's assumptions section. See config/portfolio_loader.py for the validation this file is checked against on load.
meta.schema_notes: Each bond below specifies maturity_years directly. A real-issue portfolio (a later phase) may instead give maturity_date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) and let the loader derive remaining years as of a valuation date, and may add isin / issue_date / tenor_class -- all optional, all absent here. See the SCHEMA FORWARD-COMPATIBILITY note in config/portfolio_loader.py.
